description: This file implements a fake topology manager for Kubernetes, providing mock methods for testing topology-related functionalities such as affinity, container management, and admission control.

classes.name: fakeManager
classes.description: A mock implementation of the Manager interface for testing topology management in Kubernetes.

methods.name: GetAffinity
methods.description: Returns the topology hint associated with the manager, or an empty hint if none is set.

methods.name: GetPolicy
methods.description: Returns the policy used by the fake manager.

methods.name: AddHintProvider
methods.description: Adds a hint provider to the manager, primarily for logging purposes.

methods.name: AddContainer
methods.description: Logs the addition of a container to a pod, with placeholder context handling.

methods.name: RemoveContainer
methods.description: Logs the removal of a container by its ID.

methods.name: Admit
methods.description: Simulates pod admission, returning a default admit result.
